rules.source_quote: The beneficiary must have resided in Maharashtra for at least 15 years.
rules.note: The 15-year minimum residence period cannot be held by the profile; only residence in the state is encoded.

rules.source_quote: up to ₹1.20 lakh for rural areas and up to ₹3.00 lakh for urban areas
rules.note: Limit differs by area: 120000 rural, 300000 urban. 300000 (the higher) is encoded; a rural applicant is limited to 120000.
